node.statement: Write Z=(Z_ij), X=(X_j), and Y=(Y_i). By the standard matrix amplification, [(Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)X]_i=sum_j Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_ij)(X_j). For every i,j, def-ha-map applied to Z_ij in S_{P,R}, X_j in S_{R,Q}, and Y_i in S_{P,Q} states 2*<Y_i,Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_ij)(X_j)>*u_Q=(Y_i^dagger dot Z_ij) dot X_j+Y_i^dagger dot (Z_ij dot X_j).
